column1: # Source: Google AI Edge LiteRT documentation

# Notes: Latencies are measured on Google Pixel 2 devices using a single big-core ARM CPU. Post-training quantized rows reflect dynamic-range weight quantization (8-bit weights with floating-point activations); quantization-aware training rows reflect full-integer INT8 execution. Resnet_v2_101 QAT accuracy and latency are listed as N/A in the upstream table and left blank here.
